locator: Tjänstevikt bil, traktor och motorredskap; Totalvikt bil, traktor och motorredskap; Maximilast
decision: Exact 7D drafts remain supported. Car tjänstevikt includes the driver once; maximilast is totalvikt minus tjänstevikt and covers passengers and goods. Registered maximum load is not actual remaining capacity for a trip.
